headline: Crude Oil Heads for Fourth Monthly Gain After Hormuz Tanker Attack
summary: Crude oil was positioned for a fourth consecutive monthly gain after an attack on an oil tanker near the Strait of Hormuz accentuated Middle East war-related supply risks.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint, handling a fifth of global petroleum consumption.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Heightened security threats in major maritime transit routes add a geopolitical risk premium to crude benchmarks.
